owners.label: Life Entwined
owners.description: When a Resonator other than Shorekeeper takes a fatal blow, they will not be knocked out and will instead be healed for 50% of Shorekeeper's HP while Shorekeeper loses the same amount of HP. Shorekeeper's HP will not go below 1 from this effect. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minutes.

owners.label: Self Gravitation
owners.description: When the on-field Resonator is within range of a Stellarealm, Shorekeeper's Energy Regen is increased by 10%, and Rover's Energy Regen is also increased by 10% if Rover is on the team.

owners.label: Binary Butterfly
owners.description:
Shorekeeper summons 1 Flare Star Butterfly and 1 Dim Star Butterfly to circle the Resonator on the field for up to 30s, granting the following effects:
- If the Resonator on the field is hit or launched, tapping the Dodge Button allows the Resonator to immediately recover from the interruption, triggering a successful Dodge. The Resonator launched in the air can land on the ground standing if they are close to the ground. This effect can be triggered up to 5 time(s).
- All nearby party members' DMG is Amplified by 15%.

owners.label: Unspoken Conjecture
owners.description:
The Stellarealms generated by Resonance Liberation End Loop gain the following enhancements:
- The effective range of the healing and buffs is extended by 150%
- The duration is extended by 10s.
- Casting Intro Skill Discernment no longer ends the existing Stellarealm.

owners.label: Night's Gift and Refusal
owners.description: The Outer Stellarealm now increases the ATK of all nearby party members by 40%.

owners.label: Infinity Awaits Me
owners.description: Casting Resonance Liberation End Loop grants Shorekeeper 20 Concerto Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 25s.

owners.label: Overflowing Quietude
owners.description: Gain 70% additional Healing Bonus when casting Resonance Skill Chaos Theory.

owners.label: Echoes in Silence
owners.description: Extend the ranges of the pulling effect of Basic Attack Stage 3 by 50% and Illation by 30%.

owners.label: To the New World
owners.description: Increase the DMG Multiplier of Intro Skill Discernment by 42%. Casting Intro Skill Discernment increases Shorekeeper's Crit. DMG by 500%.

tags.name: Traction
tags.desc: Pulls targets within range towards a specific position

tags.name: DMG Amplification
tags.desc: Provides DMG Amplification for a specific Resonator in the team
